title: Monity Desktop: Free Website Monitoring for Mac and Windows
excerpt: Watch web pages for changes, check uptime and run browser tests from a free app on your Mac or Windows PC. No account, no subscription, no credits.
content_html:
Website monitoring that runs on your own computer.

Watch pages for changes, check that sites are up and test that sign-up still works, from a free app for Mac and Windows. No account, no subscription, no credits.

Page changes. Watch a whole page, one element or an area, for text or visual changes, as often as every 5 minutes, with a picture of exactly what changed.

These are the app’s own screens, from version 0.3.2 on a Mac.

Why run it on your computer

Free, private, and it reaches what the cloud can’t.

It sees what your computer sees

Checks start from your own computer, so local addresses work: your dev server, your router, a site on your VPN. For pages behind a login, sign in once in Monity’s own browser; the session stays on your computer, encrypted.

Free, and nothing goes to Monity

There is nothing to sign up for and nothing to pay. The app sends no error reports and no usage data, and your monitors and their history stay on your computer.

It keeps checking from the menu bar

Close the window and checks carry on, from the menu bar on a Mac or the system tray on Windows.

Alerts arrive where you already look

A notification on your computer, an email through your own mail server, a message in Discord or Microsoft Teams, or a webhook. Each one opens what it is about.

  • It updates itself. Each new version is offered in the app, and your monitors and their history carry over.
  • It moves with you. Export your monitors, their history and your settings to one file, and import it on another computer.
  • The Mac app is signed. Both Mac downloads are signed and notarized by Apple.

Bring your own AI

Use the AI you already pay for.

AI is optional. Connect a model and it describes each change in plain words, and Ask Monity sets up monitors and answers questions about them. Without one, everything else still works.

Use Claude Code or Codex if they are on your computer, Ollama, your own API key, or a built-in model that downloads once and runs offline.

It works with your AI tools too. Claude Code, Codex and other MCP clients can create and review your monitors, through Monity’s local MCP server.

Desktop or cloud

Same Monity, two places to run it.

What

Monity Desktop Free, on your Mac or Windows PC

Monity in the cloud A free plan, and paid plans for more

Where checks run

On your computer, while it is on and the app is open

On Monity’s servers, around the clock

While your computer is off

Checks wait until you open the app again

Checks keep running

Price

Free. No account, no subscription, no credits

A free plan with no card, and paid plans for more

Your monitors and history

Stay on your computer

In your account, with a full-page screenshot and a saved HTML copy of every version

Local addresses

Your dev server, your router, a site on your VPN

Only addresses the internet can reach

Alerts

Desktop notifications, email through your own mail server, Discord, Microsoft Teams and webhooks

Email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, Telegram, Google Sheets, webhooks and phone push, on every plan

For teams and the public

One person, one computer

Team workspaces, public status pages and heartbeat monitors for cron jobs

Version 0.3.2 · Release notes

Download Monity Desktop.

Free for Mac and Windows. Install it, paste a link, and your first check runs a moment later.

  • This computer Mac with Apple Silicon M1 or later · .dmg

    Download

  • This computer Mac with Intel Intel processors · .dmg

    Download

  • This computer Windows Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit · .exe

    Download
  • Installing on a MacOpen the dmg and drag Monity AI to Applications. The app is signed and notarized by Apple.
  • Not sure which Mac you have?Open the Apple menu and choose About This Mac. “Chip” means Apple Silicon; “Processor” means Intel.
  • Installing on WindowsIf you see “Windows protected your PC”, choose More info, then Run anyway. The installer is not code-signed yet.
Is Monity Desktop really free?

Yes. There is no account, no subscription and no credits: the app runs on your own computer. If you want checks that keep running while your computer is off, Monity in the cloud has a free plan too.

Do checks run while my computer is off or asleep?

No. Checks run while the app is open. Close the window and it keeps working from the menu bar on a Mac or the system tray on Windows, but nothing is checked while the computer sleeps or is shut down. For checks around the clock, use Monity in the cloud.

What does the app send to Monity?

Nothing. It sends no error reports and no usage data, and it checks for updates without an id of your install. The pages you watch are opened from your own connection, and if you connect an AI model, what it reads goes to the model you chose.

Which Mac download do I need?

Open the Apple menu and choose About This Mac. If it lists a Chip such as Apple M1, M2, M3 or M4, take the Apple Silicon download. If it lists an Intel Processor, take the Intel one.

Why does Windows say “Windows protected your PC”?

The Windows installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows shows that warning the first time. Choose More info, then Run anyway. The Mac downloads are signed and notarized by Apple.

Does the app update itself?

Yes. It offers each new version by itself, and your monitors and their history carry over.

Can I move my monitors to another computer?

Yes. Export your monitors, their history and your settings to one file and import it on the other computer. Passwords and keys are entered again there; saved sign-ins go along only if you choose.

Need checks around the clock?

Monity in the cloud keeps checking while your computer is off, and keeps a full-page screenshot and a saved copy of every version of the page.

  • Free plan, no card
  • Every alert channel on every plan
